package: RePath AI four source integration pack

sources.name: DOSM Job Market Insights
sources.automation: Periodically check official release page; import verified published tables/data. No stable public JMI API verified.
sources.role: Local demand observation: advertised online job offerings by occupational group and selected professions
sources.limit: Not live vacancies; some categories are broad; does not measure AI job replacement; Q1/Q2 statistics cannot be indiscriminately compared across changed breakdowns.

sources.name: arXiv AI RSS
sources.automation: Public RSS fetch; cache and timestamp; respect terms and modest request rate
sources.role: Observe new AI papers and dated research topics (early signal only)
sources.limit: Preprints are not validated industry adoption; never infer automatic job losses from papers.

sources.name: WEF Future of Jobs Report 2025
sources.automation: Update reference when newer official reports are released; no verified public live data API
sources.credential: no key for web reading; reuse restrictions may apply
sources.role: Long-term 2025–2030 occupational and skill outlook; background and scenario rationale
sources.limit: Survey estimates and forecasts, not observed 2026 Malaysian job postings or a real-time feed.

sources.name: O*NET 31.0 Database
sources.publisher: O*NET Program / U.S. Department of Labor
sources.cadence: quarterly releases; web services track latest release
sources.automation: Download official versioned CSV/JSON tables or use registered O*NET Web Services API (X-API-Key)
sources.credential: registration and API key required for Web Services (downloads may not need a key)
sources.role: Occupation taxonomy, tasks, skills, transferable skills, skill-gap matching
sources.limit: US occupational reference requires explicit mapping and review for Malaysian relevance; attribution CC BY 4.0 subject to exceptions.
